column1: # Obligation clusters watched by abstractions/gate.py (abstraction-discovery "The gate").
#   kind = theorems : every theorem/lemma whose file matches the glob and name matches the regex
#   kind = ledger   : hand cost of GENERATED cases, from a ledger TSV (case, hand_lines, source)
#          in proof order; selector = <ledger.tsv>::<glob of the generated files>. Every generated
#          case must have a row, so the gate can never be blind to generated work.
#   kind = arms     : the case arms of the named theorems (one case = one obligation)
# A cluster is "re-baselined" by a line `baseline <id> <commit>` in an adopted ROUND-<n>.md
# decision: only cases introduced after that commit count.
